definitions: The action of forming something into the shape of a cup.
The action of holding or enclosing something with the hands in the shape of a cup.
A therapeutic technique involving placing cups on the skin to create suction.
examples: She was cupping her hands to catch the water.
The artist was cupping the clay to form a bowl.
He is cupping his ear to hear better.
The therapist is cupping the patient's back.
